quest.title: Time Waits For No Man
quest.description: Mondstadt's crisis has passed, but Cyrus seems... unhappy?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x2000, Guide to Freedom x2

talks.objective: Check the suspicious location and eliminate any threats

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: A signboard blown away by the wind... Flowers blown away by the wind... A lost cat... *sigh* It is as I expected...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Back so soon? Well then, I suppose nothing serious is happening...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No, there's still a lot of monster activity.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: What? There are still monsters wandering around, and in even greater numbers than before?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: That's strange. Wasn't the large force that attacked Mondstadt defeated previously? Why are they still skulking about in the area?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Could they have some other plans? ...I must gather the adventurers and re-issue our commissions. We cannot take these monsters lightly.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Conducting careful investigations into the activities of monsters in the wild falls within the purview of the Adventurers' Guild. It's time to show everyone what we're made of!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. Please take these as thanks for you efforts.
